projects.title: Invoice Collection & Escalation Automation
projects.summary: Automated invoice follow-up and escalation workflow with AI-generated financial reporting.
projects.description: An end-to-end invoice follow-up system that categorizes outstanding invoices by aging thresholds and automatically escalates through multi-stage notification routing — from client email reminders to internal Slack alerts. Includes AI-generated executive financial summaries delivered as weekly Google Docs reports.
